associations.rationale: The formal type gives a multiplicative equivalence from a finite commutative group G to the character group of its character group, directly expressing the double-dual isomorphism.
The equality says that the image of g in the double dual sends every character χ to χ(g), precisely the evaluation formula in the source claim.
The Nonempty MulEquiv type asserts existence of an equivalence between a finite commutative group and its character group, directly capturing the noncanonical dual isomorphism.
